data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to access native LINE SDKs for LINE Login integration.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to integrate LINE Login features, letting users authenticate using their LINE credentials or a web page. Provides methods for login, logout, fetching user profiles, access token management, and verification.
use_when: You need to allow users to sign in with their LINE account in your Flutter app.
Your app requires LINE login capabilities on iOS 15+ and Android API 24+.
avoid_when: Your project targets an older Flutter version below 3.44.0.
You do not use LINE Login services.
strengths: Official LINE SDK wrapper for Flutter.
Supports automatic token refreshing and profile retrieval.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration for iOS and Android (Info.plist, build.gradle).
Stict platform requirements (iOS 15.0+, Android minSdk 24, Flutter 3.44+).
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring LINE Login channel settings in the LINE Developers console, adding URL schemes/queries in ios/Runner/Info.plist, raising minimum iOS deployment target to 15.0, and updating Android minSdk to 24.
